reviewText: Really impressed by RUMMY 888. The UI transitions are smooth, matchmaking is fast, and table mechanics feel natural.
Graphics aur design toh badhiya hai but offline AI algorithm scales up too fast. 3 wins ke baad computer achanak se unbeatable ho jata hai, please balance the difficulty a bit.

The gold and black theme looks incredibly premium. Love playing the offline mode during my daily metro commute because it doesn't drain my battery. Just wish there were a few more free avatar designs to choose from.
Auto-group button setup is amazing yaar! Cards automatically sets ho jaate hain aur game play bohot fast hai. No lag at all on my Redmi.
Excellent interface and stable connection even on mobile data. Kudos to Nexus Casual Studios for this polished experience.
Clean layout and intuitive rules. Performance is smooth, would just appreciate a toggle for low-power mode.
Overall a solid experience with RUMMY 888. The gameplay is very fluid, just hoping the next update adds more custom card themes.
Decent performance and fair matchmaking, but the sound effects can get slightly repetitive. Good casual app overall.
